outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic domain map combined with western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of densitometry quantification derived from single blots shown in panel A (no error bars or replicate n stated), so it does not represent an averaged value requiring individual points.
Panel C is a heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D is a violin plot, which already displays the full data distribution and is exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Bar chart shows mean ± SD (n=4) with individual replicate data points overlaid as circles on each bar.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatter plot; individual points are inherently the data, so overlay is not applicable.
Panel H is a scatter plot of individual IP-MS experiments; individual points are already the displayed data.
Panel I is a PCA scatter plot; each point already represents an individual sample, so no averaging is involved.
Panel J is a set of PCA scatter plots; each point already represents an individual sample, so no averaging is involved.
